div.head: II Cn 69
div.ab: Þis is þonne seo lihtingc, þe ic wylle eallon folce gebeorgan, þe hig ær þyson mid gedrehte wæran ealles to swyðe.
Þis is þonne lihtingc, þe wille eallon folce gebeorgan, þe hig ær þysson mid gedrehte wæron ealles to swiðe.
Hec est igitur alleuiatio, quam omni populo meo preuideri uolo, in quibus nimis omnino fuerant aggrauati.
Ðis is ðonne se lihtingc ðe ic wylle eallon folce gebeorgan, ðe hig ær ðyson mid gedrehte wæron ealles to swyðe.
Þis is þonne seo lihtingc þe ic wylle eallon folce gebeorgan, þe hig ær þyson mid gedrehte wæran ealles to swyðe.
Folgendes ist nun die Erleichterung, wodurch ich allem Volke Schutz gewähren will [dávor], womit sie bisher allzu sehr bedrückt gewesen sind.
The following, now, is the relief by which I wish to give all the people protection [against that] with which they have hitherto been all too greatly oppressed.
Now this is the mitigation by means of which I desire to protect the general public in cases where, until now, they have been far too greatly oppressed.
Now this is the mitigation by which I wish to protect all the people from what they were hitherto oppressed with all too greatly.
Accordingly, this is the mitigation by which I mean to protect the people in cases where they previously were all too greatly oppressed.
div.note: Liebermann suggests correcting A to ‘seo lihtingc, þe ic wille’.
